japaneseTitle: 呪術廻戦 第3期 死滅回游 前編
shortDescription: Yuji Itadori and his allies enter the deadly Culling Game, where sorcerers fight for survival in a dangerous battle orchestrated by Kenjaku.
fullDescription: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 3 adapts the Culling Game arc from Gege Akutami's hit manga. Following the Shibuya Incident, Yuji Itadori and his allies face a new supernatural crisis involving deadly barriers, powerful sorcerers, and a battle royale with devastating consequences. The season premiered in January 2026.

japaneseTitle: 葬送のフリーレン 第2期
shortDescription: Frieren, Fern, and Stark continue their journey north as the elf mage explores the meaning of time, friendship, and the lives of those she meets.
fullDescription: The second season of Frieren: Beyond Journey's End continues the fantasy adventure of the long-lived elf mage Frieren and her companions. After the Demon King's defeat, Frieren seeks to understand humanity and the memories of her former party. The new season premiered on January 16, 2026, continuing the emotional journey through a richly developed fantasy world.

shortDescription: Gabimaru and his companions return to the mysterious island to face terrifying creatures and powerful enemies while searching for the Elixir of Life.
fullDescription: Hell's Paradise Season 2 continues the dark fantasy story of Gabimaru, a powerful ninja sentenced to death, and Sagiri, the executioner assigned to him. Their dangerous mission to obtain the Elixir of Life takes them deeper into a mysterious island filled with deadly creatures and supernatural threats. The second season premiered on January 11, 2026.

shortDescription: Aqua and Ruby continue their search for the truth while navigating the ruthless entertainment industry, complicated relationships, and the secrets behind their mother's death.
fullDescription: Oshi no Ko Season 3 advances the story of Aqua and Ruby Hoshino as their careers enter a new stage. Six months after B-Komachi's latest release, the entertainment industry presents fresh opportunities and challenges. Aqua continues investigating the truth behind Ai's death, while Ruby grows increasingly determined to pursue her own ambitions. The season premiered on January 14, 2026.

japaneseTitle: 炎炎ノ消防隊 参ノ章 第2クール
shortDescription: Shinra Kusakabe and Special Fire Force Company 8 confront the mysteries of the Great Cataclysm as the final battle for humanity approaches.
fullDescription: Fire Force Season 3 Part 2 continues the story of Shinra Kusakabe and his fellow firefighters as they uncover the truth behind spontaneous human combustion and the Evangelist's plans. As the conflict escalates, Company 8 faces increasingly dangerous enemies and revelations that threaten the future of the world. The second part premiered in January 2026.

shortDescription: A distorted Holy Grail War unfolds in the United States as powerful mages and heroic spirits clash in a battle filled with deception and dangerous mysteries.
fullDescription: Fate/strange Fake introduces a new Holy Grail War in Snowfield, United States. Unlike previous conflicts, this battle is built on incomplete information, unusual summons, and competing factions. Masters and Servants enter a chaotic struggle in which the rules of the ritual are distorted. The television anime began airing in January 2026, and a new series was announced in August 2026.

animeTitle: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 4
japaneseTitle: Re:ゼロから始める異世界生活 4th season
shortDescription: Subaru Natsuki and his companions embark on another perilous journey, facing new enemies and desperate challenges in a world where his ability to return from death remains crucial.
fullDescription: Re:ZERO Season 4 continues Subaru Natsuki's struggle to protect his friends in a fantasy world governed by dangerous magic and political intrigue. As the story progresses into a new arc, Subaru and his allies confront new threats and difficult choices. The season premiered in April 2026, with its second story section beginning in August 2026.

japaneseTitle: とんがり帽子のアトリエ
shortDescription: Coco dreams of becoming a witch in a world where magic seems reserved for the chosen few, until a mysterious magician reveals a secret that changes her life.
fullDescription: Witch Hat Atelier follows Coco, a young girl fascinated by magic who discovers that spells are created through special drawings rather than an inborn magical gift. After meeting the traveling magician Qifrey, she begins learning the secrets of witchcraft and enters a world of wonder, danger, and strict magical rules. The anime adaptation premiered on April 6, 2026, with animation by BUG FILMS.
